rules.text: Shared spaces go quiet at 9:30pm, and any calls are taken in our own rooms at low volume.
No parties; text everyone the day before guests come, and keep weekend gatherings to 4 people or fewer, gone by 9pm.
We follow a weekly rotating chore chart with fixed tasks, bathroom included, and hold a 10-minute check-in on Sundays before 8pm.
It's a strict vegetarian kitchen, wiped down after every meal, with morning cooking kept quiet and finished by 7am.
We split utilities and basic groceries equally on Splitwise, and the deposit is up to one month's rent.
We keep the thermostat between 68 and 72°F.
